summary:
The app is built at `desk:apps:temp` and works in my manual checks: typing `35` shows `F: 95`, `35.6` shows `F: 96.08`, and `-40` shows `F: -40`. Non-numbers and empty text show `F: ?`, letters are ignored, and Backspace removes the last character.

I wrote it as a single 27-line page with no extra pages, so `desk:apps` holds only `temp`. Its `start` gives `''`, `key` takes digits, `-` and `.` and handles Backspace, and `draw` shows row 1 as `C: …` and row 2 as `F: …` at column 1. It never reads or changes other pages. I did not run the Unseen OS `test` command, since that would have needed an extra test page.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give ''
done
task key(s, k)
  set r to s
  when k is 'backspace'
    when count(s) is 1
      set r to ''
    done
    when count(s) > 1
      set r to slice(s, 1, count(s) - 1)
    done
  done
  when find('0123456789-.', k) > 0
    set r to s & k
  done
  give r
done
task draw(s)
  set f to 'F: ?'
  when is_number(s)
    set f to 'F: ' & text((number(s) * 9 / 5) + 32)
  done
  show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s)
  show(2, 1, f)
done
